intent: Build one local_gbp_conversion priority-growth improvement for haveo in the isolated worktree

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Existing homepage repair: clarify app purpose and foreground its existing download action while preserving Haveo artwork and guide layouts.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Acciones secundarias más pequeñas y con menos texto. Un turbo no debe ocupar el mismo protagonismo que la misión o el salto.
visual_evidence.comparison: Compare the current baseline with this repair: the branded mascot stays intact; peripheral decoration stops overlapping phone text; the App Store button precedes smaller secondary links.

references.borrow: Keep the Haveo mascot, warm background, Quicksand and blue rounded download control.
references.avoid: Three equal-weight actions and floating decorations over the reading area.

brief.visitor: A person searching for Haveo who wants networking-event preparation on iPhone or iPad.
brief.promise: Identify Haveo and reach its existing App Store listing from the opening screen.
brief.primary_action: Download on the App Store, using the unchanged site-hero campaign URL.
brief.friction: Download currently competes with equally prominent social and feedback buttons; phone decorations overlap explanatory copy.

kpi.outcome: App Store handoffs per human homepage session; installs measured separately.
kpi.denominator: Human sessions landing on the homepage, excluding synthetic and known bot traffic.
kpi.baseline: Search snapshot: 1 click / 77 impressions in seven days; 0 / 22 in final 72 hours. No handoff or install baseline supplied.
kpi.evidence: Immutable brief 341ef6a2518369dea78d964b0f436bf9ce04b7c082227b2c26c64d3a8d801e78, rehashed in this run.
kpi.readout: Growth lead retrieves homepage handoff baseline and compares equivalent 14-day windows after release.
kpi.decision_rule: Keep if measured handoffs improve with adequate comparable traffic; sparse data stays inconclusive; revert if friction or conversion worsens.

concept.idea: One clear download action with small optional social and feedback links.
concept.brand_reason: Retain Haveo yellow character, soft background, Quicksand, and rounded blue controls.
concept.interaction: Tap or keyboard-activate the existing download link.
concept.visible_response: Pressed button state; Chromium opens the listing destination; WebKit native handoff requires a device check.
concept.direct_path: Existing App Store href remains a plain HTML link, including with JavaScript disabled.
concept.alternatives: Retain the baseline if the coordinator rejects the hierarchy; no new scene or component system is needed.

story.opening: Identify the app, its platform, and the event-preparation use case.
story.action: Choose Download on the App Store.
story.consequence: The unchanged campaign link hands off to Apple.
story.next_step: Review and install in the App Store; no install completion is claimed by the site.

content.visible: App purpose, download, free availability, privacy reassurance, and compact secondary actions.
content.optional_html: Existing native details FAQ stays in initial HTML.
content.linked_depth: All existing generated guide links remain unchanged.

references.borrow: Existing Haveo artwork and button language; current shared RailFaq native-details pattern.
references.avoid: Equal visual weight for social/feedback, overlapping decorative characters on phone, invented local business facts.

components.reuse: Existing Haveo button, shared first CSS block and delegated App Store event listener; no kit defect identified.
components.local_reason: A small static homepage composition repair needs local scoped CSS. React RailFaq installation would add an unrelated runtime; existing details already works.

verification.rendered_states: WebKit and Chromium at 375x667, 390x844, 390x600 and 1280x800; before/after frames.
verification.motion: Retain existing float; new press feedback respects reduced motion. No new narrative animation or scene.
verification.accessibility_performance: 44px actions, focus rings, touch, keyboard, no horizontal overflow. Full-page gate AMBER before/after; existing contrast and type warnings remain.
verification.raw_html: App explanation, plain App Store link, FAQ and updated date present without JS; generator round trip and copy/page contracts.
verification.conversion_boundary: Live Apple listing returned HTTP 200; synthetic input and attribution delivery blocked from GA4. Native iPhone installation and production conversion pending.
